visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black baseball cap and a black t-shirt with a small logo stands in a modern kitchen. He is positioned in front of stainless steel shelves filled with cookware and green plants, speaking directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and active hand gestures. (2) A close-up view features a pink fish fillet resting on a black slate board. A pair of hands enters the frame to gently pat the fish dry using a white paper towel, showing the detailed texture of both the food and the absorbent paper. (3) The man whisks a creamy, off-white batter in a large metal bowl. The scene cuts to a black pan filled with bubbling hot oil where pieces of battered fish are frying, turning a rich golden-brown color as they move in the liquid. (4) Hands use a metal mesh strainer to lift crispy fried potato wedges from the hot oil. The man is then shown placing the fried items onto a white paper towel, which begins to show small oily spots as it absorbs moisture. (5) A golden retriever dog with light golden fur is shown eating greens from a small white bowl. This scene takes place in a living room area with a soft orange sofa and light-colored walls visible in the background environment. (6) The man sits on the orange sofa, dipping a piece of fried fish into a small cup of creamy sauce and eating it with a satisfied expression. He then gestures toward several large plastic-wrapped packs of May Flower kitchen towels arranged on a table. (7) A close-up shot focuses on the white paper towel being used to wipe the snout of the golden retriever. The man is then seen demonstrating the towel's thickness and absorption by folding it over a piece of food on the slate. (8) The final scene takes place outdoors in front of a large Costco Wholesale warehouse. The man holds two massive multi-packs of kitchen towels, one in each hand, while smiling broadly and looking directly into the camera lens.
